arguments.title: Case-sensitive import breaks CI
arguments.body: Same lesson, reworded: ./Foo vs foo.tsx bites only in Linux CI.

canonical.title: Vite build fails on case-sensitive import
canonical.body: The import used ./Foo but the file is foo.tsx; works on macOS, fails in CI.
canonical.author: devon

response.instruction: Compare your write with the canonical node's body: if it contradicts or updates it rather than restating it, call supersede with old_id set to the canonical id to make your version the current fact.

note: `instruction` is a static string present on EVERY merged envelope, mirroring the pending envelope's (design/07, July 2026 revision). It is the engine's half of the caller contract ruled 2026-07-21: auto-merge cannot distinguish a restatement from a negation, and `addendum_added: true` otherwise reads as "your information is stored" when the addendum is get-only and never re-embedded -- so search and briefing keep serving the stale body as the current fact. resolve_duplicate's and inbox_review(promote)'s merged outcomes carry it identically; import mode strips the report.
